crossRefs.note: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means…
Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself…
I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self…
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
“Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into…
Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will…
Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

translations.web: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
translations.bsb: consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
translations.kjv: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
translations.asv: let him know, that he who converteth a sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall cover a multitude of sins.
